set.body: The R comparison harness shared_density.R uses jsonlite digits=NA, which can round an evaluation coordinate across an exact support boundary. A direct-sum oracle then selects different finite-support cells even when the native estimator is correct. Fresh synthetic reproduction: seq(-1,7,length.out=11), boundary 3.2-1.8; the original grid and its digits=NA round trip have different counts at or below the boundary; digits=17 round-trips exactly. Update numeric evidence export to round-trip doubles, add a synthetic boundary regression, and preserve named tolerances. No eyesim arithmetic defect established. The current private spatial run uses an external corrected wrapper and preserves the failed attempt; frozen repository sources are unchanged. Existing passing prior oracles are not reclassified as failures.
set.title: Private density parity: preserve floating-point axes across R JSON export
